notes.title: Big update with new game mode!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Hive!

Finally, a big update! We've added a new game mode in which you can reconsider your attitude to the fight between bees and hornets, because now you will command the attack on the hives. You will have access to 18 missions, the goal of which will be to destroy only the necessary bee infrastructure and accumulate as much strength as possible for the final battle!

[previewyoutube=KhVMDv47qXU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/2a515b76a92e4297af058663c98afd33af625a67.png"][/img]


Before the start of each mission, you will have access to a certain amount of money, with which you can hire an army of hornets, moths and dragonflies. Sometimes the tasks can be simple, and you can figure out how to complete them with the help of a couple of hornets. Then you will save some of the money and it will go to you in the next mission, which may not be as simple as the previous one.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/ce6cc075884d461d30065508053da00b11643d71.png"][/img]



And most importantly - you will be able to personally participate in the thick of the battle, as if you found yourself in 1942 and you have to survive in the sky over the ocean under fire from enemy anti-aircraft guns. Personal control and pinpoint targeting to complete tasks will bring the hornets the most success!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/ef2e9935a36fbb65246a972fc586d9709a1f5eac.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/c03ff4cef9fba9678064054faa8c6264858deea3.jpg"][/img]
And also, for completing the new mode, you will receive a new unique support unit, with which it will be interesting to replay the main mode.


We also noticed that the game looks much more interesting if the bees end up in an ocean of oil or, for example, blood. Now in the settings there is an option to change the color of the ocean :) 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/3d27cb97eeb7352a6eb8e937b385f29925eef88f.png"][/img]


Now we understand how funny it is 
that all this was not there from the very beginning and added to the game:[/p][list][*][p]The ability to have more than 1 save[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to change the difficulty level of the game in normal mode[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to change the control keys[/p][/*][*][p]An additional window with a more detailed tutorial, which can be opened at any time[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to change the screen resolution :)[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to disable VSync[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to change the quality of graphics[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the annoying sound of pointing and pressing buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed problems with Thai and other Asian fonts
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who wrote their wishes, about bugs and just shortcomings![/p]

notes.title: The update is being postponed!
notes.notes:
Hello, bees!

In the last message, we told you about the upcoming update and promised to release it this week. We carefully read all your feedback and comments - they are what inspired us to add new ideas and improvements.

As a result, the list of tasks has grown significantly, and we realized that we will not be able to complete the work on time. In order not to release an update with errors, we decided to postpone the release.

The update will be released on June 26 - the first day of the summer sale!
This way, we will be able to please you with a stable and full-fledged version. Thank you for your support and patience!

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a massive update with a new game mode!

It's time to switch sides — now you'll be playing as the hornets! Destroy beehives, complete combat missions, and manage limited resources. 17 exciting missions await you, where you can recruit hornets and moths, launch powerful missile strikes, and save up coins throughout the campaign.

And that's not all — take control of bombers and hornets with machine guns to plunge into heated battles and feel like a real fighter on the front lines!

[previewyoutube=KhVMDv47qXU;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, we've fixed a number of bugs, improved performance, and fixed fonts for Thai, Korean, and Vietnamese — to make the game even more convenient for everyone.

The update is coming next week!

notes.title: Special Offer!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today our game will be on the main page of Steam all day. We decided that this is a good reason for a 70% discount.

And also - now our development team is working on a new update, but we will be able to announce the release date of this update later. We are very pleased that many players write not only reviews, but also open new topics in the game community, where they offer new interesting solutions, write about bugs and generally share impressions.

It is really very important for us to know any opinion about the game in order to make it better. Thank you!

Offer of the day

notes.title: Lightning Update
notes.notes:
We are happy to tell you that we have prepared 2 updates for the autumn and winter sales. The update in December will be simply thematic, but the current update has made the game more dynamic!

Royal scientists have invented personal weapon sets for bees. So far, these sets are too expensive and bulky, so the Queen has ordered that they be given only to the best bee warrior. It is up to you to decide who is the best!

Now the player will have the opportunity to move into bees and control them as combat helicopters with a minigun or as a starship with lasers. Now you can destroy hornets both on the ground and in the air!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/92c1b44313fdd81ddc37ee4d8bf73b617b96ec02.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/eb08a1ea7894f493545da7386f154d691c025bf0.gif[/img]

And so that life does not seem like honey - we inform you that cyclones with lightning and thunderstorms now pass over the waters of the bee island. Lightning periodically strikes the building and sets them on fire. Now the Queen will need more workers to repair them. But the worst thing is that lightning can hit the bees - this will not end well for the bee. Thank goodness, Bee scientists have invented a lightning rod that will save the lives of royal workers.

The player will need to place lightning rods and monitor their presence after the waves to avoid unnecessary losses due to lightning!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/32e77db79494b3f1587b0f67e495a55d96fa75a0.png[/img]

Also, scientists are trying to create a time machine, so we can talk a little about the future.

The mechanics of FPS controller for bees introduced in this update laid the foundation for a larger update with a new game mode, where the player would have the opportunity to play in first person for hornets, dragonflies and moths in different scenarios.

It is not yet clear when this large update will be ready.

We are currently busy looking for a publisher that we like and will help with our ideas. This is quite possible, but it takes time. Most likely, this will happen only next year.

Of course, if we find a suitable publisher :)

In the meantime, our team is very grateful to everyone who wrote about bugs and made their suggestions in the Steam and Discord communities.

Good luck in the battle against the hornets and long live the queen!

notes.title: Update! Nuclear Missiles and Creative Mode!
notes.notes:
Long live the queen and her scientists!

New features:

1) Creative game mode with cheats and wave editor
2) New weapons: "Trio" and "Nuclear Rocket"
3) New research in the fourth era
4) New level of standard enemies - hornets, dragonflies, moths.
5) Improved game performance by 5-7%
6) Fast construction with the mouse button pressed
7) Reload icon for some weapons
8) Changed the balance of waves. Added new waves
9) Now all research is step-by-step and in order to start research of the next era - it is necessary to complete research of the previous era

Scientists have subjugated space and now we can bring down artificial black holes on the hornets. The Trio cannon is now the most powerful weapon in the last era.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/2f72c0b68850e5721bda20517780e582e3a12bfb.png[/img]

The crowning glory of this update was the intercontinental ballistic missile. This is probably the most impressive building in the game. It takes up a huge number of cells, is expensive, but launching this missile gives pleasant emotions and allows you to destroy all enemies on the map :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/e320c6acf87dfb12e2cf9ae7a774fc9728c71604.png[/img]

In creative mode, the player has access to a set of cheats and a wave control panel to independently simulate the collision of bees and hornets. Want to pit 100 bees against 100 hornets - go ahead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/29a011daf2aaba1fa7a04ed9cf210504a981ff2c.png[/img]

notes.title: Updates
notes.notes:
Long Live the Queen!

We are pleased to announce that we are finally ready to show the update. Almost 7 months have passed since the last update was released. Many players could rightly think that we abandoned this game, deceiving everyone who was promised an update. But that's not true. We, as developers, love this game, because it became our first game on Steam and despite the fact that we are developing another game, we are devoting time to working on updating Bee Island.

We'll be releasing an update this summer and splitting it into two parts for two events on Steam. The summer sale will begin on June 27, and the festival of tower defense games will start on July 29.

In the first update we will add a new era, resources, factories, enemies and new buildings, and in the second - a new game mode, weather conditions and even more buildings, weapons and research in the new era. We also slightly improved optimization and fixed a number of bugs.

We continued to read player reviews all this time and we are very grateful to everyone who took the time to give fair criticism and helped us make the game better!

Thanks to everyone who has been protecting the queen from the hornets all this time with us!

notes.title: Postponement of the update release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We work like bees, but this did not save us from postponing the update!

In the last message we wrote that we were going to add a new era, game mode, weather, etc. to the game. During the development process, at almost every stage we were faced with the fact that we were not happy with the results of our work, there were new ideas and what had already been done before was been polishing. Because of this, there was more work, and we liked the idea of ​​limiting ourselves to a certain date less and less, because otherwise we would not have time to do everything as we planned.

Also, since we don't have a publisher, we handle all the legal issues ourselves. This also takes a lot of time and sometimes forces us to be distracted from development. We still have not received money from the sales of the game and are unlikely to receive it before December due to the legal peculiarities of our country, company, bank, etc. But we do not despair and continue development with the money that we have left.

Now, I think its enough of our whining and you're ready to see what we've already done!

We have done a lot of work and are pleased to announce that from a technical point of view the new game mode is ready, and now we are developing levels and an UI for it. The game mode will be similar to TABS and Beseige.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/0aa0b9dee06f806b7a11fc93ac193f3cddb98f08.png[/img]

Also, we have completely thought through the new era. In the fourth era, the player will have access to 2 new resources. Plasma and energy. They will be produced in the corresponding buildings and will be spent by defensive buildings. For example, a plasma gun will not be able to shoot endlessly like a minigun; it will consume plasma from its storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/a47905ac24bc55889e01b7c5f98dd688c89b7f07.png[/img]


New units of bees and enemies will appear in the game. And at the end of the era, the player will face a boss who, with his size and power, will become a real challenge and will make the ending more difficult.

[previewyoutube=abf472vovss;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/b7659b1a0bf32271a9832d3c411cd82e903b37da.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/f24678075bef21304e76f40bb3f0aee634cfd317.jpg[/img]


Night and weather conditions will appear in the game, including a thunderstorm, during which lightning will set buildings on fire. To minimize the damage, it will be necessary to build lightning rods.

[previewyoutube=4LeKN4Vg7UE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update plan
notes.notes:
Hello bees!

Bee Island has collected 200 reviews today. 85% of them are positive. We are very glad that you liked the game and would like to thank everyone who wrote to us about bugs in it. We try to read each of your messages and each of your feedback. We understand that some players may find the game lacking in content, so here's our roadmap for the next big update.

[h1]Update 5 October 2023[/h1]

[list]
[*] Challenge mode, in which the player will have access to 10-15 levels. This mode will resemble the main game mode in TABS. At each level, the player will see all the enemies that attack him. The player will need to correctly spend resources on the buildings and bees available at this level in order to defeat all enemies.
[*] New era. There are currently 3 eras available in the game. We will add new research in the research center and the fourth era. In this era, the player will have access to new turrets, special buildings, new bees and new resources. In addition, a new type of opponents will appear, which will make the gameplay more diverse.
[*] The change of night and day. Change of weather. Several weather conditions will be added to the game: Fog, rain, thunderstorm. They have different effects on buildings and bees.
[*] Wonders of the world and islands. Already now you can notice Stonehenge on the game map. We will add a few more islands with ancient buildings. The player will be able to activate these buildings and receive bonuses.
[*] Management of bees from the first person. The player can now fire turrets in first person. We will add the ability to control bees as well. Coupled with a new type of bee, it will be interesting.
[/list]


The update will be released on October 5th and will be marked by a big discount. We hope that all of the above will be included in this big update, but if plans change, we will be sure to inform you on our Disrod server and community group on Steam.

Also, I remind you that collectible cards, backgrounds and icons will soon become available to players.

notes.notes:
Hello bees!

We've added the ability to manually prioritize buildings for bees. The bees now carry resources according to these priorities. Now that the game has resource statistics and manual priority setting, it's more like a strategy game. 

We will continue to add more features and fix bugs that you write to us about. If you have any ideas, you can send them to us on Discord. We would love to see any suggestions!

Today's update changes:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to manually select priorities in buildings. The bees now carry resources according to these priorities. (Thanks to ThePinkPolarbear77, E.B. and Old)
[*] Added progress to achieve Doom. Now 1000 hornets need to be destroyed not in one game, but as a whole. (Thanks TacoCat)
[*] Added frame limiting setting (Thanks to My Dude, I Am Here)
[*] Weapon sound is reduced by 30% when firing in first person
[*] Fixed mistakes in the names of achievements. (Thanks to the egg and chingmire)
[/list]

notes.title: Bee Island | Steam Strategy Fest
notes.notes:
Hello, bees!

Especially for the strategy festival, we have added a window with statistics to the game. In it you can see the exact number of units and buildings in your base. You can open this window by clicking on the queen, who sits in the center of the hive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/6dc4fe2f06d249aa37bd0d9752d91fefd1173811.png[/img]

Now we are working on adding to the game the ability to upgrade already built buildings and enemy markers (How many of them and where they come from)

We are already working on improving Chinese, Korean and Japanese translations. If you are ready to help us with this - write to us on the discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/VVYpFSygjv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/9cddc4ddd760501140306172fe323efe1ab77a66.png[/img][/url]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345020/Bee_Island/

[h1]About the game[/h1]

Bee Island is a minimalistic top-down strategy game where the player has to manage the production of resources, select technologies to learn and build defenses. 

Waves of hornets, dragonflies and ladybugs attack the hive. In order to defend against them, it will be necessary not only to build crossbows, cannons, machine guns and rocket launchers, but also personally shoot them!


Thank you!!
Team of Lemma Arts

notes.title: DevBlog №1
notes.notes:
Hello! Nice to meet you!

We are an indie studio of three. And we love what we make!
Bee Island is the first game we release on Steam and we look forward to your feedback on it. We love this game since we had the idea for it back in 2020. We want to make this game better and any of your ideas will help us in this. You can write to us at any time in our Discord server!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44205887/4ab2cacf09d7e7e47a3bd32a6a196518d2824b9a.png[/img]

Also, I would like to express my deep gratitude to everyone who helped us with testing and translating the game in our Discord server!

Now the game has 1 game mode available - "Story". In it, you have to go through a short history of the hive, and protect it from the evil hornets that encroach on your honey again and again. Choose your path of development and decide at what cost you will get victory in this war. Will you decide everything peacefully, or is it impossible to do without a nuclear bomb?

In the future, we plan to add another mode - "Battles", where a player without research will be able to immediately use all the resources to repel waves of opponents and go further through the levels. I will tell you more about it in the next devblogs!
